Ordo XIIII." with page number 216 at top left; below it a centred italic caption line and a second line; a large woodcut illustration of a squilla (mantis shrimp) occupying the middle; below the picture two lines of caption (GALL. and GERMANICA); below that one main text column of running text, with small marginal notes in the left margin (Vrsa minor. / Cicada mar.; Cammarus. / Gammarus.) and a right-hand text running to the right edge; the last line "eiusdem" set at right.

main_text.head: Eiusdem pictura alia, quam Romae depictam Vrsi nomine, Corn. Sittardus nobis donauit.
main_text.p: GALL. Nostris litoribus incognita est, & ob id anonymos, Rondeletius.
GERMANICA nomina fingo, ab Vrso quadrupede: ein Bär/Meerbär/Bärenkrebs.

Vrsa minor.Cicada mar.SQUILLA caelata Rondeletij, Vrsa minor Bellonij. Quam hic proponimus (inquit Rondeletius) nostri Cicadam mar. uocant. alij Cicadam mar. (Aeliani) eam esse opinantur, quam nos Mantin nominamus. Eā quidē de qua nunc agimus Cicadā potiore ratione nominandā esse censuimus, ob maiorem cum Cicadis terrestribus similitudinem: Squillam uerò, tum quòd supra dictę similis sit, tum quòd bracchia priora indiuisa habeat, qua nota Squillas à Locustis & Cancris secerni diximus. Caelatam uerò, ut ab alijs internoscatur. nam quinq; tabellis constat, & dorso, egregio naturæ artificio uariè caelatis et sculptis. Tota rubet, idq; magis quàm ullū aliud crustatum, siue cruda, siue cocta. Hanc Squillæ speciem esse puto, quam antiqui Cammarum (Latinè quidam etiā Gammarū uocauerūt, authoribus Athenæo, Plinio, Columella. Hæc Rondelet. A Græcis κάμμαρος uel κάμμαρις scribitur; de quo plura Rondeletius in historia Aštaci scripsit: & nos in eiusdem

page.notes: Woodcut of a squilla (mantis shrimp) occupies the centre of the page; no text inside it. Marginal notes: "Vrsa minor." and "Cicada mar." (left, first paragraph); "Cammarus." and "Gammarus." (left). The Greek words κάμμαρος and κάμμαρις are reproduced approximately. The head line is a caption above the picture, not a heading in the strict sense. Words of the right-hand margin cut off at the scan edge may be incomplete.
